name: buena-graphs
title_zh: 正文旁直接插文本图，不碰绘图软件
tagline_zh: 写文档要配图？不用切工具、不用画 ASCII。从 buena-mono 目录调官方纯文本孪生图。
tagline_en: Need charts in docs? No tool-switching or ASCII art. Pull official plain-text twins from buena-mono, or install.
desc_en: Insert text-first graphs beside prose. Copy official plain-text twins from the buena-mono catalog for markdown, terminal, or chat output; install the React components from the registry for JSX/MDX hosts. Use when an explanation, report, README, PR body, or doc needs a chart, graph, sparkline, timeline, gantt, status strip, or any data figure - and instead of inventing ASCII art or reaching for Mer
why_zh: 图与文同源：数据改动只改一处，图表自动同步。官方目录保证样式统一，不是临时拼的散装符号。
why_en: Single source of truth: edit data once, charts sync. Official catalog keeps style consistent—no ad-hoc symbol soup.
limit_zh: 只出文本图（sparkline、甘特、状态条等），不生成位图或矢量图；需网络拉取 buena-mono 目录。
limit_en: Text-only figures (sparklines, gantts, status strips); no raster/vector output. Needs network for buena-mono catalog; React components require.
title_en: Text-first graphs beside prose, no drawing tools
